content_blocks.title: Why Wireless and Mobile Security matters

content.text: Wireless and Mobile Security is one of those topics that shows up in real incidents, not just in slides. If you can explain it cleanly, you can make better calls under pressure.

content_blocks.simplified_explanation: Think of Wireless and Mobile Security as one piece of the incident puzzle that helps you understand what happened and what to do next.

content_blocks.real_world_connection: When a real incident hits this domain, Wireless and Mobile Security helps you decide what to check first and what not to waste time on.

content_blocks.title: Wireless and Mobile Security in plain English

content.text: Wireless and Mobile Security is the operational idea behind this lesson. The point is not memorizing words. The point is knowing what the thing does, where it breaks, and how attackers or defenders use it.

content_blocks.simplified_explanation: Say it like this: Wireless and Mobile Security is the thing you use when you need to understand, manage, or defend this part of the incident workflow.
